# My Impression of Keigo Higashino
The first work by Keigo Higashino that I read was probably *The Miracles of the Namiya General Store*.

I remember it was when I was in elementary school. I was spending my summer vacation at my cousin’s house, and since there were no phones to play with back then, I had no choice but to read. As it happened, there was a copy of *The Miracles of the Namiya General Store* there. Judging solely by the title, I thought it would be a light, slice-of-life kind of book. It turned out to be quite fascinating. The redemption brought about through letters sent across time left a deep impression on me, and I remembered the author.

The next time I encountered his work was in my second year of high school.

At the time, people in our dormitory started passing around *Journey Under the Midnight Sun*. I remember that at least three of us read it on the same Kindle. We were genuinely so engrossed that we barely ate or slept—it was almost as intense as binge-watching *Breaking Bad*. BTW, even when I read online novels, I was never as enthusiastic as I was with this one. When it was my turn to read it, I would basically finish my homework as quickly as possible during self-study periods and then sneak a look, read while eating, and keep reading even after the dormitory lights had been turned off (thank goodness for this backlit Kindle). It was my first time reading a mystery novel with such mature subject matter. Although it was dark, it also had a certain sense of realism, and the way the main plot progressed through the alternating perspectives of the male and female leads was quite interesting. More importantly, the story was full of twists and turns, and it was very difficult to guess who the killer was. The most heartbreaking part was that Ryoji Kirihara ultimately protected Yukiho by taking his own life, only for Yukiho to say expressionlessly, “I don’t know this person at all.”

The next time I encountered “Yukiho” was in *The Phantom Night*. This story wasn’t as compelling as *Journey Under the Midnight Sun*, though it was still fairly decent. The ending of *The Phantom Night* was also very similar to that of *Journey Under the Midnight Sun*: the male protagonist eventually discovers that the female protagonist has been deceiving and using him all along, but in the end, he still takes his own life to protect her, allowing her to escape without suspicion.

I won’t go into all his other books one by one. The image below shows the works by Keigo Higashino that I’ve read.
![Works by Keigo Higashino that I’ve read|475](https://img.muelsyse.us/bed/20260808043442545.png)


Keigo Higashino was a great writer. I’m grateful to him for enabling someone like me, who isn’t accustomed to reading, to concentrate and finish an entire book. I’m also grateful for the stories he created, which stay with you long after you’ve finished them.

R.I.P.

# 我對東野圭吾的印象
我第一次閱讀東野圭吾的作品，應該是他的《解憂雜貨店》。

我記得那時候還在國小，暑假在表姐家玩。那時沒有手機可以玩，於是只能看書了，剛好有一本《解憂雜貨店》。單從書名來看，我以為是日常休閒類型的書呢。這本書相當精彩，透過跨越時空的信件實現救贖，也讓我記住了這位作者。

下一次再相見就是高二了。

當時我們宿舍開始傳閱《白夜行》，我記得至少有三個人是用那台 Kindle 看完《白夜行》的。當時真的是廢寢忘食，跟追《絕命毒師》有得一比。順帶一提，我追網路小說都沒有追這本那麼積極。輪到我看的時候，我基本上就是自習課抓緊時間寫完作業後開始偷偷看、邊吃飯邊看，寢室熄燈了也繼續看（感謝這款有背光的 Kindle）。這是我第一次看這種尺度有點大的懸疑小說，雖然黑暗，卻又有一種真實感，而且男女雙視角的主線推進也滿有意思的。更重要的是，劇情確實相當跌宕起伏，凶手很難猜。最讓人意難平的是，桐原亮司最後透過自殺保護了雪穗，雪穗居然能面無表情地說出：「我完全不認識這個人。」

後來再次見到「雪穗」就是在《幻夜》中了。這個故事寫得沒有《白夜行》精彩，也算差強人意吧。《幻夜》的結局也和《白夜行》很像，男主角最後知道了女主角一直在欺騙和利用自己，但是最後他還是為了保護女主角而自殺，讓女主角清白脫身。

其他書就不一一贅述了，下面圖中是我看過的東野圭吾作品。
![看過的東野圭吾作品|475](https://img.muelsyse.us/bed/20260808043442545.png)


東野圭吾是一位偉大的作家，感謝他讓我這個不習慣看書的人也能集中精神讀完一本完整的書，也感謝他創作的故事讓人回味無窮。

R.I.P.

title: Building a Personal Website with Cloudflare
description: "Site architecture: two Workers, one SQL database, and one object store"
createdAt: 2026-08-13T00:00:00.000Z
updatedAt: 2026-08-13T00:00:00.000Z
published: true
tags:

  - Build a Website
  - Optimization
slug: 20260813-02

## Quote

My website runs on two Cloudflare Workers, a SQL database, and an object store. Comments, likes, and view counts update in real time; my book, music, and movie collections have their own admin dashboard; and my music rankings sync automatically every night. Aside from the domain, the rest costs practically nothing.

This article introduces its architecture.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  V[访客浏览器] --> D[DNS / 优选 CNAME]
  D --> E[入口 Worker]
  E -->|Service Binding| A[Astro SSR Worker]
  A --> S[静态资源]
  A --> Q[(D1 数据库)]
  A --> R[(R2 对象存储)]
  A --> X[外部 API]

  C[Cloudflare Access] -.保护后台.-> E
  K[Cron] -.每日定时同步.-> A
```
## A Single Request's Path

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant B as 浏览器
  participant E as 入口 Worker
  participant A as Astro SSR Worker
  participant D1 as D1 / R2

  B->>E: HTTPS 请求
  E->>A: 内部调用（Service Binding）
  alt 静态资源
    A-->>E: 直接返回带哈希的 CSS / JS / 图片
  else 页面或 API
    A->>D1: 查询或写入
    D1-->>A: 结果
    A-->>E: HTML / JSON
  end
  E-->>B: 补上安全响应头后返回
```

## Database Design

D1 is Cloudflare’s managed SQLite database, used to store structured data such as comments, likes, view counts, and metadata for books, music, and films in your collection.

R2 stores all images: illustrations in articles and collection covers. The main reason I chose it is that egress traffic is free—bandwidth charges are the bane of image hosting. R2 stores only the files; the metadata for those files lives in D1, and the two are linked by object key.
## Image Pipeline

I write articles in Obsidian. The moment I paste an image, the image-hosting plugin uploads it directly to R2, leaving a URL in the Markdown. There are no image binary files anywhere in the repository, so the Git history never bloats.

At build time, the script generates multiple AVIF and WebP variants at several widths for each image the first time it appears (640 / 1280 / 1920), uploads them to the same directory in R2, and records the mapping in a manifest. When rendered, the URL in the Markdown remains unchanged, but the resulting HTML contains a complete `<picture>` element: the browser selects the smallest file sufficient for the viewport and pixel density, the first image in the article loads at high priority, and the rest are lazy-loaded. The original image URL always remains valid as a fallback.

## A Little Money-Saving Strategy

>If your site is a purely static blog, Astro with static asset hosting is all you need—you don’t need a Worker at all.

If you need comments, an admin panel, or scheduled tasks, D1 with an SSR Worker is relatively inexpensive.

### Worker
Requests for static assets do not execute any code and do not count toward Workers’ 100,000 free requests per day. CSS, JavaScript, fonts, and locally hosted images all fall into this category—they’re free and unlimited. The only things that actually use up the 100,000 free requests per day are HTML rendering and API calls that require code to run.

So I have as many requests as possible handled at the static layer. Only paths that require dynamic processing are configured to pass through a Worker first. This keeps request usage largely within the free tier.

### D1
Keep an eye on D1’s row reads. The free tier allows 5 million rows per day, but it counts rows scanned, not rows returned. A query that returns 20 comments could count tens of thousands of rows if it scans the entire table instead of using an index. Adding indexes to commonly filtered fields and paginating lists can help you make the most of D1’s free tier.

###  A Note on Free-Tier Limits
The “zero cost” claim here needs a qualification: excluding the domain, the bill is approximately zero as long as traffic and data usage remain within the free tiers. The specific limits are as follows (July 2026):

| Item           | Free allowance               |
| ------------ | ------------------ |
| Dynamic Worker requests | 100,000/day, shared across the account       |
| Static asset requests       | Free, unlimited             |
| D1           | 5 million row reads/day, 100,000 row writes/day |
| R2           | 10 GB of storage, free egress traffic    |

Note that 100,000 is the free daily limit for the entire account, not 100,000 per Worker.

Important: D1 charges based on rows scanned. Queries without indexes can cause your bill to skyrocket.

## Accelerated Access from Mainland China

Cloudflare’s default entry point is Anycast, with routing determined by BGP—which isn’t always ideal for China’s three major carriers. The same site may load quickly on China Telecom, while China Mobile traffic during evening peak hours may take a roundabout route and suffer packet loss. My solution is to use a CNAME optimization service: point the domain’s CNAME record to a target domain that continuously measures performance and updates its DNS results.

Once traffic enters the site, speed depends on layered caching; the rules are based on how frequently each type of content changes:
- Content-hashed CSS, JS, and fonts: cached for one year
- HTML: `no-cache`Revalidate each time to ensure the latest code is being used.
- Dynamic APIs such as comments and statistics: cache at the edge for 15 seconds; write requests always use `no-store`.
- GitHub contribution graphs are cached for 6 hours, and WakaTime data is cached for 15 minutes.

title: 基於 Cloudflare 建構個人網站
description: 此網站架構介紹：兩個 Worker、一個 SQL 資料庫、一個物件儲存空間
createdAt: 2026-08-13T00:00:00.000Z

## 引文

我的這個網站運行著兩個 Cloudflare Worker、一個 SQL 資料庫和一個物件儲存。留言、按讚和瀏覽量都是即時的，書影音收藏有自己的管理後台，聽歌排行每天凌晨自動同步。而在帳單中，除了網域之外，其他部分的成本幾乎等於零。

這篇文章介紹其架構

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  V[访客浏览器] --> D[DNS / 优选 CNAME]
  D --> E[入口 Worker]
  E -->|Service Binding| A[Astro SSR Worker]
  A --> S[静态资源]
  A --> Q[(D1 数据库)]
  A --> R[(R2 对象存储)]
  A --> X[外部 API]

  C[Cloudflare Access] -.保护后台.-> E
  K[Cron] -.每日定时同步.-> A
```
## 單一請求鏈路

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant B as 浏览器
  participant E as 入口 Worker
  participant A as Astro SSR Worker
  participant D1 as D1 / R2

  B->>E: HTTPS 请求
  E->>A: 内部调用（Service Binding）
  alt 静态资源
    A-->>E: 直接返回带哈希的 CSS / JS / 图片
  else 页面或 API
    A->>D1: 查询或写入
    D1-->>A: 结果
    A-->>E: HTML / JSON
  end
  E-->>B: 补上安全响应头后返回
```

## 資料庫設計

D1 是 Cloudflare 託管的 SQLite 資料庫，用來儲存結構化資料：留言、按讚、瀏覽次數、書影音收藏的中繼資料等等。

R2 儲存所有圖片：內文插圖、收藏封面。選它的主要原因是出口流量免費，圖床最怕的就是流量費。R2 只儲存檔案，而與這些檔案對應的中繼資料在 D1 裡，兩邊透過物件鍵相互關聯。
## 圖片處理流程

我在 Obsidian 裡寫文章，貼上圖片的瞬間，圖床外掛就直接把它傳到 R2，Markdown 裡留下的是一個線上 URL。儲存庫裡從頭到尾都沒有圖片二進位檔案，git 歷史不會膨脹。

建置時，腳本會為每張首次出現的圖片產生 AVIF 和 WebP 的多個寬度版本（640 / 1280 / 1920），傳回 R2 的同一個目錄，並將對應關係寫入 manifest。渲染時，Markdown 裡的那個 URL 不變，輸出的 HTML 卻是完整的 `<picture>`：瀏覽器會依據視窗大小和像素密度，挑選最小且足夠的檔案，內文第一張圖片以高優先權載入，其餘圖片則延遲載入。原圖 URL 永遠有效，作為備援。

## 省錢小策略

>如果你的網站是純靜態部落格，Astro 加上靜態資源託管就夠了，連一個 Worker 都不需要。  
如果需要留言、後台和排程工作，使用 D1 搭配 SSR Worker，成本會比較低。

### Worker
命中靜態資源的請求不會執行程式碼，也不會計入 Workers 每天 10 萬次的免費請求額度。CSS、JS、字型和本機圖片都屬於這類，不但免費，而且沒有用量限制。真正會消耗每天 10 萬次免費額度的，只有需要執行程式碼的 HTML 渲染和 API 呼叫。

所以我讓盡可能多的請求停留在靜態層。只有必須動態處理的路徑，才會設定為先經過 Worker。這樣一來，請求的用量基本上都能控制在免費額度內。

### D1
留意 D1 的讀取列數。D1 每天的免費額度是 500 萬列，但計算的是掃描的列數，而非回傳的列數。查詢若回傳 20 則留言，但沒有使用索引而是掃描整張資料表，計入的讀取列數可能高達數萬列。替常用的篩選欄位建立索引，並為列表分頁，這些最佳化都能充分利用 D1 的免費額度。

###  注意免費額度限制
這裡所說的零成本有個前提：除了網域費用之外，流量和資料量都在免費額度內時，帳單才約等於零。免費額度如下（2026 年 7 月）：

| 項目           | 免費額度               |
| ------------ | ------------------ |
| Workers 動態請求 | 10 萬次/天，帳戶共用       |
| 靜態資源請求       | 免費，不限量             |
| D1           | 500 萬行讀取/天，10 萬行寫入/天 |
| R2           | 10 GB 儲存空間，出口流量免費    |

注意，10 萬次是整個帳戶每天的免費上限，不是每個 Worker 各 10 萬次。

特別注意：D1 會按掃描的資料列計費，未建立索引的查詢可能會讓帳單暴增。

## 中國大陸訪問加速

Cloudflare 的預設入口是 Anycast，路由由 BGP 決定，對中國大陸三大電信業者不一定友善。同一個網站，透過電信可能很快，透過行動網路在尖峰時段則可能繞路或丟包。我的做法是優先選用 CNAME：將網域 CNAME 到一個會持續測速並更新解析結果的目標網域。

進站後的速度靠快取分層，規則依內容的變動頻率決定：
- 含內容雜湊的 CSS／JS／字型：快取一年
- HTML：`no-cache`，每次都要重新驗證，以確保使用的是最新的程式碼
- 留言、統計這類動態 API：邊緣快取 15 秒，寫入請求一律 `no-store`。
- GitHub 熱力圖快取 6 小時，WakaTime 快取 15 分鐘。

## Automated Pipeline Workflow
All checks, asset processing, and deployment are handled by GitHub Actions and automatically synced to Cloudflare.
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[本地 Git Push] --> B[GitHub Actions]
  B --> C[自动化校验 / 测试]
  B --> D[站点与资源构建]
  B --> E[部署到 Cloudflare]
```

1. **Push from Localelujara**: Push Markdown content to the GitHub repository via Git.
2. **CI Trigger**: GitHub Actions capture`push`Trigger the event and start the build container.
3. **Automated Processing**: Run the content checks, build static assets, and package the SSR output in sequence.
4. **Cloudflare Deployment**: Invoke Cloudflare Wrangler to update the live service directly.

## GitHub Actions Configuration

Create it in the repository’s root directory.`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`:

```yaml
name: Deploy to Cloudflare

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run checks
        run: npm test

      - name: Build and deploy
        run: npm run deploy
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
```

### Key Configuration Details
In your GitHub repository settings, under`Secrets and variables -> Actions`Add`CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`and`CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`.

en:content.blog.基于Cloudflare构建个人网站.md.se.translation: Quote

My website runs on two Cloudflare Workers, a SQL database, and an object store. Comments, likes, and view counts update in real time; my book, music, and movie collections have their own admin dashboard; and my music rankings sync automatically every night. Aside from the domain, the rest costs practically nothing.
This article introduces its architecture.
Database Design
D1 is Cloudflare’s managed SQLite database, used to store structured data such as comments, likes, view counts, and metadata for books, music, and films in your collection.
A Little Money-Saving Strategy
Worker

If your site is a purely static blog, Astro with static asset hosting is all you need—you don’t need a Worker at all.

If you need comments, an admin panel, or scheduled tasks, D1 with an SSR Worker is relatively inexpensive.

Requests for static assets do not execute any code and do not count toward Workers’ 100,000 free requests per day. CSS, JavaScript, fonts, and locally hosted images all fall into this category—they’re free and unlimited. The only things that actually use up the 100,000 free requests per day are HTML rendering and API calls that require code to run.

Keep an eye on D1’s row reads. The free tier allows 5 million rows per day, but it counts rows scanned, not rows returned. A query that returns 20 comments could count tens of thousands of rows if it scans the entire table instead of using an index. Adding indexes to commonly filtered fields and paginating lists can help you make the most of D1’s free tier.

So I have as many requests as possible handled at the static layer. Only paths that require dynamic processing are configured to pass through a Worker first. This keeps request usage largely within the free tier.

The “zero cost” claim here needs a qualification: excluding the domain, the bill is approximately zero as long as traffic and data usage remain within the free tiers. The specific limits are as follows (July 2026):

Note that 100,000 is the free daily limit for the entire account, not 100,000 per Worker.

Important: D1 charges based on rows scanned. Queries without indexes can cause your bill to skyrocket.
D1

Cloudflare’s default entry point is Anycast, with routing determined by BGP—which isn’t always ideal for China’s three major carriers. The same site may load quickly on China Telecom, while China Mobile traffic during evening peak hours may take a roundabout route and suffer packet loss. My solution is to use a CNAME optimization service: point the domain’s CNAME record to a target domain that continuously measures performance and updates its DNS results.
Revalidate each time to ensure the latest code is being used.
Content-hashed CSS, JS, and fonts: cached for one year
GitHub contribution graphs are cached for 6 hours, and WakaTime data is cached for 15 minutes.

## Introduction

At robot competition venues such as Robocon, the network environment is often extremely complex.

At the time, my router was using the factory-default 80 MHz bandwidth, which happened to fall within the most congested frequency range. This directly caused severe stuttering in the WebRTC video stream, with latency at one point soaring above 1 second.

An on-site scan of the surrounding wireless environment detected a total of 88 actively transmitting Wi-Fi signals:

![Spectrum scan from the competition venue](https://img.muelsyse.us/bed/20261025165234244.png)

The spectrum scan shows that a large number of devices were crowded into the same channel and bandwidth ranges. Even without understanding the underlying principles of radio communication, common sense tells us that when too many cars use the same lane, traffic jams occur. Wi-Fi works the same way: choosing a lane with fewer cars should make things faster. And that is indeed what happens in practice. We only need to switch the router to a suitable bandwidth and channel to greatly improve the stability and speed of our Wi-Fi.

Here, I would like to analyze the causes of Wi-Fi stuttering from the perspective of underlying radio principles. This also serves as my own set of study notes for learning about communications.

---

## Why Does Wi-Fi Stutter?

### 1. Channel Contention and the Backoff Mechanism (CSMA/CA)

Wi-Fi uses the half-duplex CSMA/CA mechanism. Before transmitting data, a device must perform carrier sensing.

When it detects an in-band electromagnetic signal above the threshold (typically $-62 \text{ dBm} \sim -82 \text{ dBm}$), the device determines that the channel is busy and enters a random backoff period. In an environment where dozens of devices compete for access in turn, packets build up in severe queues, resulting in noticeable network latency and jitter.

### 2. Probability of Collisions from Multi-Channel Bonding

Home routers typically use a factory-default bandwidth of 80 MHz, formed by bonding four consecutive independent 20 MHz channels (see [Bandwidth and Channel Bonding](#频宽与信道绑定)). Most phones' 5 GHz hotspots are also hard-coded to channels 149 or 153.

The prerequisite for a device to transmit an 80 MHz packet is that all four bonded 20 MHz channels must be idle at the same time.

Let the probability that an individual channel is occupied by nearby devices be $p$. The joint probability that an 80 MHz channel can successfully transmit a packet is only $(1-p)^4$. In a dense Wi-Fi environment, the probability that all four channels are idle simultaneously approaches zero.

### 3. Strong Co-Channel Interference and Modulation Downgrading

The stronger the surrounding interference signals, the lower the signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (see [Signal-to-Interference-plus-Noise Ratio (SINR)](#信干噪比-sinr)).

According to Shannon's theorem (see [Shannon's Theorem](#香农定理)), channel capacity in a dense environment shrinks drastically as $\text{SINR}$ plummets. The high transmission rates advertised for Wi-Fi 6 rely on 1024-QAM modulation, which requires $\text{SINR} \ge 35 \text{ dB}$ (see [QAM Modulation](#qam-调制)).

When $\text{SINR}$ falls below the threshold, the wireless chip can only automatically fall back to a lower-order modulation, causing the transmission bandwidth to drop sharply.

---

## Solution: Balancing Channels and Bandwidth On Site

### 1. Reduce Bandwidth to Improve Interference Resistance

In high-interference environments, blindly choosing a wider bandwidth can be counterproductive. According to the thermal-noise formula (see [Thermal Noise Floor Formula](#热噪声底噪公式)), when bandwidth increases from 20 MHz to 80 MHz, the physical noise floor increases by:

$$\Delta N = 10 \log_{10}(4) \approx 6 \text{ dB}$$

Doubling the bandwidth physically raises the signal-to-noise ratio threshold required for the device to receive signals, significantly reducing overall resistance to interference.

### 2. Spectrum Scanning and Avoidance Principles

In a complex network environment, first use a spectrum-scanning tool to collect the status of surrounding signals:

- Received signal strength (RSSI)
- Operating channel
- Operating bandwidth

The core principle for channel selection is to avoid congested channels and interference sources with high transmission power. In general, it is necessary to proactively avoid frequency ranges occupied by APs with signal strengths greater than $-60 \text{ dBm}$.

### 3. On-Site Tuning in Practice

Analysis of the spectrum scan above showed that the default 80 MHz bandwidth had severe overlap with other signals. By contrast, channel 165 and channels 52 through 64 were not only relatively clear but also free of high-power interference signals.

In mainland China, channels 52 through 64 belong to the DFS (Dynamic Frequency Selection) band. Most phone hotspots lack radar-avoidance certification, so the system firmware is legally restricted from transmitting hotspots in this band. As a result, hotspot interference is rarely found in this region.

Channel 165 is suitable for operation at 20 MHz bandwidth, allowing us to sacrifice peak speed in exchange for extremely high transmission stability.

At the time, I switched to channels 52 and 56 and set the bandwidth to 40 MHz. After the switch, the WebRTC video stream immediately became smooth again, latency returned to normal, and the connection drops disappeared completely.

---

## Appendix: General Wi-Fi Theory

### AP

AP (Access Point) is the wireless access point. It is the RF transmission hub that connects a wired local area network to wireless terminals such as phones.

Home wireless routers typically integrate AP transmission, network routing, and switching functions.

### Frequency Bands

#### 2.4 GHz

- The frequency range is typically 2400 MHz to 2483.5 MHz.
- It has lower frequencies, longer wavelengths, and better wall penetration, but slower transmission speeds. Common devices include Bluetooth, wireless mice, and smart-home terminals.

#### 5 GHz

- The total available contiguous spectrum spans several hundred MHz. Common bands include 5150 to 5350 MHz and 5725 to 5850 MHz.
- It has higher frequencies, shorter wavelengths, and greater attenuation through walls. Its main advantage is its extremely high transmission speed.

### Channel Allocation

Communication protocols divide the continuous spectrum into discrete center frequencies at fixed intervals. Each designated frequency point and the physical bandwidth it occupies are collectively referred to as a channel.

Adjacent channel numbers are spaced 5 MHz apart, while the Wi-Fi standard defines the physical spectral width of an individual channel as 20 MHz.

To prevent adjacent channels from overlapping within the 5 GHz band, channel numbers must be separated by four units, such as 36, 40, 44, and 48, or 149, 153, 157, and 161.

### Bandwidth and Channel Bonding

Common Wi-Fi bandwidths include 20 MHz, 40 MHz, 80 MHz, and 160 MHz.

#### 20 MHz

Taking 802.11ac as an example, a 20 MHz physical channel is divided into 64 subcarriers, including 52 effective data subcarriers responsible for carrying data packets.

#### 40 MHz / 80 MHz / 160 MHz

Wider bandwidths use channel bonding. Taking 80 MHz as an example, the RF and baseband systems concatenate four consecutive 20 MHz channels, such as 149, 153, 157, and 161, at the underlying level. According to Shannon's theorem, channel capacity increases as bandwidth expands.

When bonding multiple channels, the router must designate one of them as the primary channel. The router's management frames are transmitted over the primary channel using a 20 MHz bandwidth, ensuring that older devices can still connect with normal compatibility.

### Shannon's Theorem

$$C = B \cdot \log_2 \left( 1 + \frac{S}{N + I} \right)$$

- $C$: Maximum channel transmission rate
- $B$: Physical bandwidth
- $S$: Received useful-signal power
- $N$: Ambient background thermal noise
- $I$: Co-channel interference power

### Thermal Noise Floor Formula

$$N = k \cdot T \cdot B \implies N \propto 10 \log_{10}(B) \quad (\text{dBm})$$

- $B$: Physical bandwidth
- $N$: Physical background thermal noise

Increase in the noise floor when bandwidth increases by a multiple:

$$\Delta N = 10 \log_{10}\left(\frac{B_2}{B_1}\right)$$

Each time the bandwidth doubles, the background thermal noise received by the device necessarily increases physically by $3\text{ dB}$.

### Signal-to-Interference-plus-Noise Ratio (SINR)

- **SNR** (signal-to-noise ratio): $\text{SNR} = \frac{S}{N}$
- **SINR** (signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio): $\text{SINR} = \frac{S}{N + I}$

$$\text{SINR}_{(\text{dB})} \approx P_{\text{自身信号}}(\text{dBm}) - P_{\text{相邻干扰}}(\text{dBm})$$

- $P_{\text{自身信号}}$: Received signal strength (RSSI) of the local router
- $P_{\text{相邻干扰}}$: Signal strength of nearby interference sources on the same channel

### QAM Modulation

Traditional modulation methods use one-dimensional level switching or phase reversal, transmitting only 1 bit at a time.

QAM modulation divides the amplitude and phase of orthogonal electromagnetic waves into a two-dimensional constellation grid. The receiver distinguishes the grid states to decode multiple bits simultaneously.

| Modulation | Data Payload per Subcarrier | Required SINR Threshold |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1024-QAM (Wi-Fi 6 top-tier configuration) | 10 bit | $\ge 35 \text{ dB}$ |
| 256-QAM (Wi-Fi 5 standard configuration) | 8 bit | $\ge 28 \text{ dB}$ |
| 64-QAM | 6 bit | $\ge 22 \text{ dB}$ |
| 16-QAM | 4 bit | $\ge 15 \text{ dB}$ |
| QPSK (fallback mode) | 2 bit | $\approx 6 \sim 10 \text{ dB}$ |

## 前言

在 Robocon 等機器人競賽現場，網路環境往往極其複雜。

當時我的路由器使用出廠預設的 80 MHz 頻寬，剛好落在最擁擠的頻段。這直接導致 WebRTC 影片串流嚴重卡頓，延遲一度飆升到 1 秒以上。

我使用工具掃描現場周遭的無線環境，共發現 88 個正在發射的 Wi-Fi 訊號：

![比賽現場掃頻圖](https://img.muelsyse.us/bed/20261025165234244.png)

從掃頻結果可以看出，大量裝置都擠在相同的頻道與頻寬範圍內。不必了解無線電的底層原理，光憑直覺也知道，一條車道上車子太多就會塞車，Wi-Fi 也是如此。那麼，選一條沒什麼車的車道，不就能開得更快嗎？實際上也的確如此：只要將路由器切換到合適的頻寬與頻道，就能大幅提升 Wi-Fi 的穩定性與速率。

接下來，我想從無線電的底層原理出發，分析 Wi-Fi 卡頓的原因，也把這當成自己學習通訊相關知識的筆記。

---

## 為什麼 Wi-Fi 會卡？

### 1. 頻道競用與退避機制（CSMA/CA）
Wi-Fi 採用半雙工的 CSMA/CA 機制。裝置傳送資料前，必須先進行載波偵聽。

當偵測到強度高於門檻值（通常為 $-62 \text{ dBm} \sim -82 \text{ dBm}$）的同頻電磁訊號時，裝置會判定頻道忙碌，並強制隨機退避。在數十台裝置輪流競用的環境下，封包會嚴重排隊堆積，造成明顯的網路延遲與抖動。

### 2. 多頻道綁定的機率性衝突
家用路由器的出廠預設頻寬為 80 MHz，由 4 個連續的 20 MHz 獨立頻道綁定而成（詳見 [頻寬與頻道綁定](#頻寬與頻道綁定)）。多數手機的 5 GHz 無線基地台也被硬編碼鎖定在 149 或 153 頻道。

裝置要傳送 80 MHz 封包，前提是綁定的 4 個 20 MHz 頻道必須同時閒置。

假設單一頻道被周遭裝置占用的機率為 $p$，那麼 80 MHz 頻寬能順利傳送封包的聯合機率僅有 $(1-p)^4$。在 Wi-Fi 裝置密集的現場，4 個頻道同時閒置的機率趨近於零。

### 3. 同頻強干擾與調變降階
周遭干擾訊號越強，信干噪比就越低（詳見 [信干噪比 SINR](#信干噪比-sinr)）。

根據夏農公式（詳見 [夏農定理](#夏農定理)），在高密度環境下，$\text{SINR}$ 暴跌會讓頻道容量大幅縮水。Wi-Fi 6 宣稱的高速傳輸仰賴 1024-QAM 調變，而此調變方式要求 $\text{SINR} \ge 35 \text{ dB}$（詳見 [QAM 調變](#qam-調變)）。

當 $\text{SINR}$ 低於門檻時，無線晶片只能自動降階至較低階的調變方式，導致傳輸頻寬斷崖式下跌。

---

## 解決方案：依現場狀況權衡頻道與頻寬

### 1. 降低頻寬，提升抗干擾底線
在高干擾環境中，盲目選擇高頻寬反而會適得其反。根據熱雜訊公式（詳見 [熱雜訊底噪公式](#熱噪声底噪公式)），頻寬從 20 MHz 增加到 80 MHz 時，背景底噪會因物理特性增加：

$$\Delta N = 10 \log_{10}(4) \approx 6 \text{ dB}$$

頻寬加倍會使裝置接收訊號時所需的信噪比門檻在物理上升高，整體抗干擾能力也會明顯下降。

### 2. 頻譜掃描與避讓原則
在複雜的網路環境中，首先使用掃頻工具收集周遭訊號狀況：
- 訊號接收強度（RSSI）
- 工作頻道
- 工作頻寬

選擇頻道的核心原則：避開擁擠的頻道，以及發射功率高的干擾源。通常需要主動避開被訊號強度大於 $-60 \text{ dBm}$ 的 AP 占用的頻段。

### 3. 現場調校實戰
分析前述掃頻結果可知，預設的 80 MHz 頻寬範圍重疊嚴重。相較之下，165 頻道以及 52 至 64 頻道不僅空曠，也沒有高功率干擾訊號。

在中國大陸，52 至 64 頻道屬於 DFS（Dynamic Frequency Selection）頻段。絕大多數手機熱點因缺乏雷達避讓認證，系統底層會依法限制其在該頻段發射熱點訊號，因此該區域極少受到熱點干擾。

165 頻道適合以 20 MHz 頻寬運作，可以犧牲極限速率，換取極高的傳輸穩定性。

當時我選擇切換到 52 與 56 頻道，並將頻寬設為 40 MHz。切換完成後，WebRTC 影片串流立刻恢復流暢，延遲降至正常水準，斷流現象也完全消失。

---

## 附錄：Wi-Fi 理論概論

### AP
AP（Access Point）中文稱為無線存取點，是連接有線區域網路與無線終端（如手機）的射頻發射中樞。

家用無線路由器通常整合 AP 發射、網路路由與交換器功能。

### 頻段
#### 2.4 GHz
- 頻率範圍通常為 2400 MHz 至 2483.5 MHz。
- 頻率較低、波長較長、穿牆能力較強，但傳輸速度較慢。常見裝置包括藍牙、無線滑鼠及智慧家居終端。

#### 5 GHz
- 可用的連續頻譜總量達數百 MHz，常見頻段涵蓋 5150 至 5350 MHz 與 5725 至 5850 MHz。
- 頻率較高、波長較短、穿牆衰減較大，主要優勢是傳輸速率極快。

### 頻道劃分
通訊協定會在連續頻譜上，依固定間隔劃分離散的中心頻率點。各個標定頻率及其占用的物理頻寬，統稱為頻道。

相鄰頻道的編號間隔為 5 MHz，Wi-Fi 標準定義的單一頻道物理頻譜寬度為 20 MHz。

為了讓 5 GHz 頻段內的相鄰頻道互不重疊，頻道號碼之間必須相隔 4 個單位（例如 36、40、44、48，以及 149、153、157、161）。

### 頻寬與頻道綁定
常見的 Wi-Fi 頻寬包括 20 MHz、40 MHz、80 MHz 與 160 MHz。

#### 20 MHz
以 802.11ac 為例，20 MHz 的物理頻道劃分為 64 個子載波，其中有 52 個是負責承載封包的有效資料載波。

#### 40 MHz / 80 MHz / 160 MHz
較高頻寬採用頻道綁定機制。以 80 MHz 為例，射頻與基頻會在底層將 4 個連續的 20 MHz 頻道（例如 149、153、157、161）串接起來。根據夏農定理，頻道容量會隨頻寬增加而提升。

綁定多個頻道時，路由器必須指定其中一個頻道作為主頻道。路由器的管理訊框只會以 20 MHz 頻寬在主頻道上發射，確保舊款裝置仍能正常連線。

### 夏農定理

$$C = B \cdot \log_2 \left( 1 + \frac{S}{N + I} \right)$$

- $C$：頻道的極限傳輸速率
- $B$：物理頻寬
- $S$：接收的有效訊號功率
- $N$：環境背景熱雜訊
- $I$：同頻干擾功率

### 熱雜訊底噪公式

$$N = k \cdot T \cdot B \implies N \propto 10 \log_{10}(B) \quad (\text{dBm})$$

- $B$：物理頻寬
- $N$：物理背景熱雜訊

頻寬成倍增加時的底噪提升：

$$\Delta N = 10 \log_{10}\left(\frac{B_2}{B_1}\right)$$

頻寬每增加一倍，裝置接收到的背景熱雜訊在物理上必然增加 $3\text{ dB}$。

### 信干噪比 SINR

- **SNR**（信噪比）： $\text{SNR} = \frac{S}{N}$
- **SINR**（信干噪比）：$\text{SINR} = \frac{S}{N + I}$

$$\text{SINR}_{(\text{dB})} \approx P_{\text{自身信号}}(\text{dBm}) - P_{\text{相邻干扰}}(\text{dBm})$$

- $P_{\text{自身信号}}$：本地路由器接收訊號強度（RSSI）
- $P_{\text{相邻干扰}}$：同頻周遭干擾源的訊號強度

### QAM 調變
傳統調變方式透過切換振幅電平或反轉相位等單一維度變化，每次只能傳送 1 個 bit。

QAM 調變將正交電磁波的振幅與相位劃分為二維網格星座圖。接收端透過判別網格狀態，同時解析多個 bit。

| 調變方式 | 單載波資料載荷 | 所需信干噪比門檻 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1024-QAM (Wi-Fi 6 頂規) | 10 bit | $\ge 35 \text{ dB}$ |
| 256-QAM (Wi-Fi 5 標配) | 8 bit | $\ge 28 \text{ dB}$ |
| 64-QAM | 6 bit | $\ge 22 \text{ dB}$ |
| 16-QAM | 4 bit | $\ge 15 \text{ dB}$ |
| QPSK (最低保底回退模式) | 2 bit | $\approx 6 \sim 10 \text{ dB}$ |

在複雜的網路環境中，首先使用掃頻工具收集周遭訊號狀況：
訊號接收強度（RSSI）
工作頻道
工作頻寬
選擇頻道的核心原則：避開擁擠的頻道，以及發射功率高的干擾源。通常需要主動避開被訊號強度大於 $-60 \text{ dBm}$ 的 AP 占用的頻段。
3. 現場調校實戰
分析前述掃頻結果可知，預設的 80 MHz 頻寬範圍重疊嚴重。相較之下，165 頻道以及 52 至 64 頻道不僅空曠，也沒有高功率干擾訊號。
在中國大陸，52 至 64 頻道屬於 DFS（Dynamic Frequency Selection）頻段。絕大多數手機熱點因缺乏雷達避讓認證，系統底層會依法限制其在該頻段發射熱點訊號，因此該區域極少受到熱點干擾。
165 頻道適合以 20 MHz 頻寬運作，可以犧牲極限速率，換取極高的傳輸穩定性。
當時我選擇切換到 52 與 56 頻道，並將頻寬設為 40 MHz。切換完成後，WebRTC 影片串流立刻恢復流暢，延遲降至正常水準，斷流現象也完全消失。

AP
AP（Access Point）中文稱為無線存取點，是連接有線區域網路與無線終端（如手機）的射頻發射中樞。
家用無線路由器通常整合 AP 發射、網路路由與交換器功能。
頻段
2.4 GHz
頻率範圍通常為 2400 MHz 至 2483.5 MHz。
頻率較低、波長較長、穿牆能力較強，但傳輸速度較慢。常見裝置包括藍牙、無線滑鼠及智慧家居終端。
5 GHz
可用的連續頻譜總量達數百 MHz，常見頻段涵蓋 5150 至 5350 MHz 與 5725 至 5850 MHz。
頻率較高、波長較短、穿牆衰減較大，主要優勢是傳輸速率極快。
頻道劃分
通訊協定會在連續頻譜上，依固定間隔劃分離散的中心頻率點。各個標定頻率及其占用的物理頻寬，統稱為頻道。
相鄰頻道的編號間隔為 5 MHz，Wi-Fi 標準定義的單一頻道物理頻譜寬度為 20 MHz。
為了讓 5 GHz 頻段內的相鄰頻道互不重疊，頻道號碼之間必須相隔 4 個單位（例如 36、40、44、48，以及 149、153、157、161）。
常見的 Wi-Fi 頻寬包括 20 MHz、40 MHz、80 MHz 與 160 MHz。
20 MHz
以 802.11ac 為例，20 MHz 的物理頻道劃分為 64 個子載波，其中有 52 個是負責承載封包的有效資料載波。
40 MHz / 80 MHz / 160 MHz
較高頻寬採用頻道綁定機制。以 80 MHz 為例，射頻與基頻會在底層將 4 個連續的 20 MHz 頻道（例如 149、153、157、161）串接起來。根據夏農定理，頻道容量會隨頻寬增加而提升。
綁定多個頻道時，路由器必須指定其中一個頻道作為主頻道。路由器的管理訊框只會以 20 MHz 頻寬在主頻道上發射，確保舊款裝置仍能正常連線。

這篇文章介紹其架構
命中靜態資源的請求不會執行程式碼，也不會計入 Workers 每天 10 萬次的免費請求額度。CSS、JS、字型和本機圖片都屬於這類，不但免費，而且沒有用量限制。真正會消耗每天 10 萬次免費額度的，只有需要執行程式碼的 HTML 渲染和 API 呼叫。
所以我讓盡可能多的請求停留在靜態層。只有必須動態處理的路徑，才會設定為先經過 Worker。這樣一來，請求的用量基本上都能控制在免費額度內。
Worker
D1
我的這個網站運行著兩個 Cloudflare Worker、一個 SQL 資料庫和一個物件儲存。留言、按讚和瀏覽量都是即時的，書影音收藏有自己的管理後台，聽歌排行每天凌晨自動同步。而在帳單中，除了網域之外，其他部分的成本幾乎等於零。
這裡所說的零成本有個前提：除了網域費用之外，流量和資料量都在免費額度內時，帳單才約等於零。免費額度如下（2026 年 7 月）：
留意 D1 的讀取列數。D1 每天的免費額度是 500 萬列，但計算的是掃描的列數，而非回傳的列數。查詢若回傳 20 則留言，但沒有使用索引而是掃描整張資料表，計入的讀取列數可能高達數萬列。替常用的篩選欄位建立索引，並為列表分頁，這些最佳化都能充分利用 D1 的免費額度。

如果你的網站是純靜態部落格，Astro 加上靜態資源託管就夠了，連一個 Worker 都不需要。  
如果需要留言、後台和排程工作，使用 D1 搭配 SSR Worker，成本會比較低。
中國大陸訪問加速
Cloudflare 的預設入口是 Anycast，路由由 BGP 決定，對中國大陸三大電信業者不一定友善。同一個網站，透過電信可能很快，透過行動網路在尖峰時段則可能繞路或丟包。我的做法是優先選用 CNAME：將網域 CNAME 到一個會持續測速並更新解析結果的目標網域。

注意，10 萬次是整個帳戶每天的免費上限，不是每個 Worker 各 10 萬次。
